value.rationale: Natural physically motivated first odd-square toroidal hard-square lattice. Known signed partition-function/Euler information is genuinely weaker than integral homotopy: it does not rule out hidden torsion, cancellation or other homological degrees. The exact wedge of nine dimension-four spheres is a new natural complete invariant with a transparent 25,531-face reproducible discrete-Morse certificate, useful for comparison with larger periodic lattices; no infinite-family result is claimed.
